newsitem.title: UK: Simpson Spence Atlantic/Pacific indices lower.
newsitem.headline: Simpson Spence Atlantic/Pacific indices lower.

text.p: The Atlantic and Pacific Capesize indices calculated by the research department of shipbrokers Simpson Spence and Young were both lower on Monday.

The Atlantic Index was 4,112 points against 4,363 points a week ago which Simpson's said reflected the softer tone for the prompter positions. But for more forward loading there is scope for the market to regain lost ground.

The Pacific Index was 4,116 points against 4,295 points a week ago and Simpson's said there was a flurry of activity in this sector after an initial stand-off between owner's and charterer's . There were signs of weakness for early positions, they said.
